svg.title: The side trips off the main line
svg.desc: Four side trips leave the main line. Worktree, before explore, makes a parallel folder and branch whose work lands with merge. Index writes the codebase map and runs on its own when the map is missing or old. The GPT or Gemini debate, from a plan or a review, argues for up to 3 rounds and ends in a verdict of agreed and disagreed points and ranked actions, which go through the same audit as review findings. Peer review takes findings you paste from another model and sorts them into real, opinion or dismissed.
